decisions.reason: Changing an interactive field label to Danish does not change the document's default Word language configuration.
The candidate requires interactive-field labels to exist, while their Danish language is independently represented by the source Requirement; the existence requirement remains unchanged.
Label language does not alter whether a placeholder clears when its field is activated.
Changing a displayed label's language does not change the selected text-entry representation or its architecture quality.
The Danish label decision does not change the Title field's formatting-retention behavior.
Label language does not resolve or alter the requirement for a visible field cue or the unresolved grey-field mechanism.
The source changes label language only and does not change whether the board-meeting dropdown control is enabled.
The source does not change the date-selection method or establish that the referenced label belongs to date-picker fields.
The Danish label decision does not change the checklist control's type or enabled status.
Changing interface-label language does not alter cross-user rendering stability or the supported Word environment.
The label-language change does not affect the legacy copy-paste workflow, layout stability, or style behavior.
The source decision has no effect on pasted table containment, column layout, or the existing feasibility conflict.
